name: Pelatiah
overview: The name Pelatiah appears in Scripture associated with several distinct individuals, each reflecting different roles within Israel's history. One Pelatiah is noted as a son of Hananiah from the family of David, highlighting his royal lineage. Another Pelatiah served as a captain of the Simeonites in a military campaign against the Amalekites, demonstrating leadership and commitment to God's people. Additionally, a Pelatiah is listed among those who solemnly pledged a covenant with Nehemiah, indicating a dedication to the restoration of the community. Finally, Ezekiel prophesies against a prince named Pelatiah son of Benaiah, who is condemned for devising mischief and giving wicked counsel, culminating in his sudden death as a divine judgment. These varied references collectively portray Pelatiah as a figure connected to leadership, covenant faithfulness, and, in one instance, divine judgment.
